label: Gun Game
description: FFA Gun Game: every frag moves the killer one weapon down a configurable ladder, a frag on the last step wins the match. Map weapons and powerups are removed, the instance needs g_infiniteAmmo 1.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns Gun Game on. FFA only. Frags count at once; map weapons and powerups go at the next map load or match start.

cvars.label: Ladder
cvars.description: Space-separated weapon:frags steps, first to last. Weapons: g mg sg gl rl lg rg pg bfg gh ng pl cg hmg. Read at match start; an invalid ladder is ignored.
cvars.default: rl:2 rg:2 lg:2 pg:2 sg:2 gl:2 mg:2 g:1

cvars.label: Gauntlet demotes
cvars.description: A death by gauntlet takes the victim one step down.

cvars.label: Suicide demotes
cvars.description: Suicides and world deaths (own splash, lava, falling, /kill) take the player one step down.

cvars.label: Gauntlet skips a step
cvars.description: A gauntlet frag moves the killer a whole step up at once, whatever frags the step still needs.

cvars.label: Weapon delay (ms)
cvars.description: Milliseconds before the new step's weapon arrives; 0 = at once. Applies immediately.

cvars.label: Spawn armor
cvars.description: Armor every player gets on spawn; 0 leaves the engine's.

cvars.label: Step notify
cvars.description: Where a player hears about their own step: print (console line), center, print,center or off.

cvars.label: Leader notify
cvars.description: Where everyone hears about the leader, the last step and the win: print, center, print,center or off.
